pretreatments.description: Physical grinding (mechanical degradation) of pine wood to achieve a homogeneous size of less than 1 mm (20 mesh) before mixing with NaOH solution.

Chemical alkali pretreatment using 8% sodium hydroxide (NaOH) solution mixed with milled pine wood for varying durations at two temperatures: 100 °C for 10, 30, and 60 minutes (shorter retention times), and 0 °C for 10, 30, and 60 minutes (longer retention times).
Combined chemical-thermal treatment involving the high-temperature NaOH pretreatment at 100 °C for 10 minutes.
Low-temperature NaOH pretreatment involving the low-temperature NaOH pretreatment at 0 °C for 60 minutes.
